cells.gaps: No source found names a second nationally owned data centre for hire at Tier III or above.
cells.note: Reassessed 2026-10-29: the state's National Data Centre and Cloud at Camama, inaugurated in April 2026 and run by Infosi, hosts public and private institutions' data on Tier III-certified modules. One national facility at Tier III is not two, so stage 4 is not reached.
